Prince Street Capital Management Lifted Gran Tierra Energy (GTE) Position; Berkshire Hathaway Cut Position in General Mtrs Co (GM) by $400.00 Million 
April 16, 2018 - By Migdalia James 
Warren Buffett decreased its stake in General Mtrs Co (GM) by 16.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Berkshire Hathaway Inc sold 10.00 million shares as the company’s stock declined 17.02% with the market. The hedge fund run by Warren Buffett held 50.00 million shares of the auto manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.05 billion, down from 60.00M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Berkshire Hathaway Inc who had been investing in General Mtrs Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $54.81B market cap company. The stock increased 1.05% or $0.405 during the last trading session, reaching $39.135. About 1.87M shares traded. General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) has risen 0.46% since April 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.09% the S&P500. 
Prince Street Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Gran Tierra Energy Inc (GTE) by 13.1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Prince Street Capital Management Llc bought 218,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.82% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1.88 million shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.11 million, up from 1.66M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Prince Street Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Gran Tierra Energy Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.17B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.66% or $0.02 during the last trading session, reaching $3. About 867,303 shares traded. Gran Tierra Energy Inc. (NYSEMKT:GTE) has risen 12.05% since April 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 0.50% the S&P500.

Analysts await General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) to report earnings on April, 27. They expect $1.31 EPS, down 22.94% or $0.39 from last year’s $1.7 per share. GM’s profit will be $1.83 billion for 7.47 P/E if the $1.31 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.65 actual EPS reported by General Motors Company for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -20.61% negative EPS growth.
